name: OneDrive for Business Storage Destination
author: McSparrow <hi@mcsparrow.dev>
description: Back up containers to OneDrive for Business via the tenant-scoped Microsoft Graph API. Targets /users/{upn}/drive (UPN field) or /drives/{drive_id} when an explicit Graph drive ID is supplied, with /me/drive as the final fallback under refresh-token auth. OAuth scopes: offline_access Files.ReadWrite.All User.Read. Same Test round-trip shape as the built-in local destination (credentials / write / change / delete). Splits the old storage-microsoft-office365 plugin so OneDrive for Business and SharePoint have dedicated plugin surfaces — install only the surface you use.
